medien.aktion.anzeigenstopp.name: Advertising ban
medien.aktion.anzeigenstopp.text: The agency cancels a paper's state advertising: it lives on it and loses income.
medien.aktion.aufsichtsstrafe.name: Broadcasting regulator fine
medien.aktion.aufsichtsstrafe.text: A fine or a programme stop: afterwards the outlet is under the regulator's watch.
medien.aktion.blackout.name: Blackout (ten days)
medien.aktion.blackout.text: The broadcaster is taken off air for ten days.
medien.aktion.eigentuemerdruck.name: Pressure on the owners
medien.aktion.eigentuemerdruck.text: The owner's contracts, loans and permits depend on the government's goodwill: one phone call is enough.
medien.aktion.interview.name: Interview offensive
medien.aktion.interview.text: You give this outlet a long interview: it reports more mildly afterwards, and its audience notices.
medien.aktion.lizenzentzug.name: Licence withdrawal
medien.aktion.lizenzentzug.text: The licence is withdrawn: the outlet stays off the air for a long time. Only possible after earlier pressure, and once per outlet.
medien.aktion.pressekonferenz.name: Press conference
medien.aktion.pressekonferenz.text: You face the press: it costs attention and wins trust.
medien.aktion.sperre_netz.name: Blocks and throttling online
medien.aktion.sperre_netz.text: Accounts, posts and sites are blocked, platforms throttled.
medien.aktion.staatsanzeigen.name: State advertising and contracts
medien.aktion.staatsanzeigen.text: Whoever receives advertising and contracts thinks twice about headlines.
medien.aktion.uebernahme.name: Takeover
medien.aktion.uebernahme.text: Someone close to the state buys the group, or a trustee is installed: the outlet then belongs to the government side. Once per outlet.
medien.aktion.verfahren.name: Charges against journalists
medien.aktion.verfahren.text: Proceedings for false reports or insult: those under investigation write more carefully.
medien.barometer.kopf: If an election were held today
medien.barometer.leer: The first poll appears after a month in office.
medien.barometer.text_institut: Approval according to {institut}, 50 are needed. The election is on {datum}, in about {monate} months. The figure is a poll, not a measurement of the truth: raw data is available in the “Media” tab of the newspaper.
medien.barometer.text_rohdaten: Approval according to your staff's raw data, 50 are needed. The election is on {datum}, in about {monate} months; the figures point to {tendenz} percent.
medien.barometer.text_start: No poll published yet; the figure is the one from the start of office, 50 are needed. The election is on {datum}.
medien.barometer.verbot: The publication ban applies before the election: no new figures appear.
medien.chronik.heute: Today {wert} percent, according to {institut} ({tage} days ago). Election on {datum}, {amtszeit}
medien.chronik.heute_rohdaten: Today {wert} percent (your staff's raw data). Election on {datum}, {amtszeit}
medien.chronik.heute_start: At the start of office {wert} percent; no poll published yet. Election on {datum}, {amtszeit}
medien.ergebnis.anzeigenstopp: State advertising for {cluster} is cancelled: income collapses and the newsroom becomes more careful.
medien.ergebnis.aufsichtsstrafe: The broadcasting regulator fines {cluster}: the outlet is under watch.
medien.ergebnis.blackout: {cluster} is taken off air for {tage} days.
medien.ergebnis.eigentuemerdruck: The owner of {cluster} is summoned: contracts and loans are under review, the newsroom leaves out more.
medien.ergebnis.interview: {cluster} runs your interview over several pages and reports more mildly afterwards.
medien.ergebnis.lizenzentzug: {cluster} loses its licence: the outlet stays off the air for a long time.
medien.ergebnis.pressekonferenz: You face the press; the questions are uncomfortable, the answers hold.
medien.ergebnis.sperre_netz: Accounts and sites of {cluster} are blocked and platforms throttled: the audience turns to workarounds.
medien.ergebnis.staatsanzeigen: {cluster} receives state advertising and contracts: the newsroom stays friendly.
medien.ergebnis.uebernahme_kauf: Someone close to the state buys {cluster}: the outlet changes its line and part of its readers leave.
medien.ergebnis.uebernahme_treuhaender: A trustee is installed at {cluster}: the outlet changes its line and part of its readers leave.
medien.ergebnis.verfahren: Proceedings are under way against journalists of {cluster}: the newsroom writes more carefully.
medien.fehler.nicht_moeglich: That is not possible right now.
medien.fehler.ohne_spiel: Without a running game there is no media policy.
medien.grund.digital_ohne_anzeigen: Digital channels do not live on state advertising.
medien.grund.erst_druck: The regulator must first put the outlet under pressure (regulator fine).
medien.grund.kapital: There is not enough capital for that.
medien.grund.kein_anzeigenhebel: This outlet does not live on state advertising.
medien.grund.kein_blackout: A blackout only applies to broadcasters and papers under supervision, not to the web.
medien.grund.kein_eigentuemerhebel: This outlet has no owner who could be put under pressure.
medien.grund.keine_aufsicht: This outlet is not under the broadcasting regulator.
medien.grund.keine_lizenz: This outlet has no licence that could be withdrawn.
medien.grund.lizenz_schon_entzogen: The licence has already been withdrawn once.
medien.grund.nicht_kaeuflich: This outlet cannot be taken over.
medien.grund.ohne_cluster: An outlet must be chosen for this.
medien.grund.oppositionell_lehnt_ab: The opposition-leaning owner does not accept state contracts.
medien.grund.regierungsnah_kein_verfahre: There is no reason to act against a pro-government outlet.
medien.grund.schon_staatsnah: The outlet already belongs to the government side.
medien.grund.staatsfunk_interview: The state broadcaster needs no interview.
medien.grund.treuhaender_erst_druck: A trustee requires the outlet to be under regulatory pressure already.
medien.kippt.log: {cluster} turns away from the government camp.
medien.kippt.warum: The owner sees the majority fading and hedges towards the other side.
medien.leak: A report about the affair leaks out: the intervention makes headlines.
medien.log.warum: Costs {kapital} capital and attention; interventions in the press have consequences at home and abroad.
medien.regler.warum: The level of media supervision is so high that critical broadcasters and papers are shut down.
medien.rohdaten.bestellt: The raw data has been ordered: {tage} more days.
medien.rohdaten.laeuft: You are seeing the raw data, {bis} more days.
medien.rohdaten.log: Raw data ordered: in {tage} days you will see the truth behind the polls.
medien.ui.dauerkanaele_text: The sliders in the policy network set the situation permanently; high levels really close broadcasters.
medien.ui.eingriffe_text: Choose an outlet above. Every intervention costs capital and attention, works in the short and long term, and provokes reactions.
medien.ui.gekippt: has broken with the government camp
medien.ui.ohne_spiel: Without a running game there are no media.
medien.ui.rohdaten_preis: Raw data costs {kapital} capital and {aufmerksamkeit} attention, arrives after {wartetage} days and holds for {gueltig} days.
medien.ui.rsf_verlauf: Course of the press freedom score
medien.ui.rsf_verlauf_leer: The course begins after the first month.
medien.ui.schublade: {institut} measured and held back the result.
medien.ui.verbot: Before the election no polls may be published: no new figures appear.
medien.ui.wahrnehmung: What you see of the mood
medien.ui.wahrnehmung_institut: {institut} measures {wert} percent ({tage} days ago, spread about ±{streuung}). The figure contains the institute's house effect and, where fear prevails, less honest answers.
medien.ui.wahrnehmung_rohdaten: Your staff shows the raw data: {wert} percent, valid for {bis} more days.
medien.ui.wahrnehmung_start: No poll published yet: the figure at the start of office was {wert} percent.
medien.ui.zweck: Who reports what the country learns, and what it costs: owners, licences, self-censorship, reach.
medien.vorschau.ausweichen: The audience turns to social networks and workarounds
medien.vorschau.finanzdruck: The outlet's income falls over months
medien.vorschau.lizenz_gedraengt: The outlet comes under regulatory pressure
medien.vorschau.maertyrer: Persecution makes the outlet better known (martyr effect)
medien.vorschau.plattform: Reach online falls, platform pressure rises
medien.vorschau.pressekonflikt: More proceedings make a press conflict likelier
medien.zeitung.umfrage_verbot: Does not appear: before the election the publication of polls is prohibited by law.
medien.zeitung.vorsicht: The newsroom is visibly printing more cautiously than usual.
medien.zeitung.zu_medien: Interventions and state of the media
